description: This file implements classes for tracing control within the WPEFramework, including TraceIterator and TraceController, which manage trace categories and enable/disable tracing respectively.

classes.name: TraceIterator
classes.description: Implements an iterator over trace categories, allowing enumeration of trace modules and categories.

classes.name: TraceController
classes.description: Provides control over trace categories, enabling or disabling tracing for specific modules and categories.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the trace iterator to the beginning.

methods.name: Info
methods.description: Retrieves information about the current trace category, including whether it is enabled, its module, and category name.

methods.name: Enable
methods.description: Enables or disables tracing for a specified module and category.
